mapper.select: SELECT boardcmt.id , boardcmt.deleted , boardcmt.created_at as createdAt , boardcmt.modified_at as modifiedAt , boardcmt.board_id as boardId , boardcmt.user_id as userId , boardcmt.content FROM boardcmt WHERE boardcmt.id = #{id}

SELECT boardcmt.id FROM boardcmt
ORDER BY boardcmt.created_at DESC
SELECT count(boardcmt.id) as listsize FROM boardcmt

SELECT boardcmt.id FROM boardcmt
ORDER BY boardcmt.id ORDER BY boardcmt.created_at ORDER BY boardcmt.created_at DESC ASC DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{perpage}

SELECT boardcmt.id FROM boardcmt
AND #{cursor} > boardcmt.id ORDER BY boardcmt.id DESC
AND boardcmt.id > #{cursor} ORDER BY boardcmt.id ASC
AND #{cursor} > boardcmt.id ORDER BY boardcmt.created_at DESC, boardcmt.id DESC
AND boardcmt.id > #{cursor} ORDER BY boardcmt.created_at ASC, boardcmt.id ASC
LIMIT 0, #{perpage}
